name: 39154 · Raymond, MS
findings: ZIP 39154 (Raymond) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39154 (Raymond) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 39154 (Raymond) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
